measures.title: Countywide 0.25% sales tax for health care services
measures.summary: Would authorize Wyandotte County to impose a one-quarter percent (0.25%) countywide retailers' sales tax. The money would pay for health care services, including indigent care, behavioral health, substance abuse, preventive health care and the County Health Department. Collection would begin April 1, 2027, or as soon after as the law allows.
measures.yesMeans: The county may impose the 0.25% countywide sales tax for health care services.
measures.noMeans: The county does not impose this sales tax.

measures.title: Additional 3/8-cent citywide sales tax for parks and infrastructure
measures.summary: Would authorize the City of Kansas City, Kansas, to impose an additional three-eighths of one percent citywide retailers' sales tax. About half of the money would finance park capital projects, including parks, community centers and trails, and about half would finance infrastructure such as roads, bridges and sidewalks. Collection would begin April 1, 2027, or as soon after as the law allows, and end ten years later.
measures.yesMeans: The city may impose the additional 3/8-cent sales tax for ten years for parks and infrastructure.
measures.noMeans: The city does not impose this additional sales tax.
